nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: CLI entrypoint that parses flags, reads config files, and builds every plugin instance.

nodes.label: flb_config_init()
nodes.desc: Creates the service context holding event loop, scheduler, storage, and plugin lists.

nodes.label: flb_start()
nodes.desc: Embedded library API so hosts can run the engine in-process instead of the CLI.

nodes.label: flb_coro_init()
nodes.desc: Initializes the coroutine subsystem that lets plugins suspend and resume without OS threads.

nodes.label: flb_engine_start()
nodes.desc: Boots the mk_event event loop, starts collectors and the metrics exporter, and blocks on events.

nodes.label: flb_engine_flush()
nodes.desc: Periodically flushes buffered input chunks and drives adaptive flush level decisions.

nodes.label: flb_engine_dispatch()
nodes.desc: For a flushed input chunk, walks matching routes and creates one task per destination output.

nodes.label: flb_input_new()
nodes.desc: Allocates an input instance from the plugin registry during configuration loading.

nodes.label: flb_input_collectors_start()
nodes.desc: Starts every registered collector: fd events, timers, and coroutine-driven ingestion.

nodes.label: flb_input_collector_fd()
nodes.desc: Event-loop handler that wakes the owning input when its watched file descriptor fires.

nodes.label: in_tail_collect_event()
nodes.desc: Tail input callback that reads new lines from watched files and tracks offsets.

nodes.label: flb_input_chunk_create()
nodes.desc: Creates a buffered chunk keyed by tag, backed by memory or the filesystem.

nodes.label: flb_input_chunk_write()
nodes.desc: Appends msgpack records into the chunk, enforcing size limits and storage rules.

nodes.label: flb_storage_create()
nodes.desc: Sets up the CIO storage layer for memory and filesystem buffering of chunks.

nodes.label: flb_parser_create()
nodes.desc: Registers named parsers (json, regex, ltsv, logfmt) that inputs apply to raw payloads.

nodes.label: Regex Backend
nodes.desc: Onigmo/Oniguruma-backed parser turning unstructured text into keyed fields.

nodes.label: JSON Backend
nodes.desc: JSON parser with time key handling and nested map decoding for structured payloads.

nodes.label: flb_ml_append_text()
nodes.desc: Multiline engine that folds stack traces and continuations into single logical records.

nodes.label: flb_log_event_decoder_next()
nodes.desc: Iterates msgpack log event envelopes so filters and outputs can read records safely.

nodes.label: flb_filter_do()
nodes.desc: Runs a chunk through every filter instance in its configured chain order.

nodes.label: cb_grep_filter()
nodes.desc: Grep filter callback that keeps or drops records using regex and exclude rules.

nodes.label: cb_lua_filter()
nodes.desc: Lua filter callback that rewrites records with user-supplied scripts.

nodes.label: flb_ra_create()
nodes.desc: Record accessor engine used by filters and processors to address nested keys like $kubernetes['pod_name'].

nodes.label: flb_router_match()
nodes.desc: Wildcard tag matcher deciding which configured outputs receive a chunk.

nodes.label: flb_router_connect()
nodes.desc: Wires input instances to output instances at initialization from match rules.

nodes.label: flb_event_chunk_create()
nodes.desc: Wraps buffered data into an event chunk that carries type (log/metric/trace) and tag.

nodes.label: flb_task_create()
nodes.desc: Creates one in-flight task per routed destination, tracking output references and state.

nodes.label: flb_task_retry_reschedule()
nodes.desc: Requeues failed deliveries with exponential backoff until retry limits are hit.

nodes.label: flb_sched_timer_create()
nodes.desc: Scheduler timers powering retry backoff and periodic flush intervals.

nodes.label: flb_output_thread_pool_flush()
nodes.desc: Dispatches task flushing onto output worker thread pools with coroutines.

nodes.label: cb_forward_flush()
nodes.desc: Forward output callback serializing chunks in Fluent Forward Protocol over TCP/TLS.

nodes.label: flb_upstream_create()
nodes.desc: Builds a pooled upstream of network nodes with TLS and proxy support.

nodes.label: flb_http_do()
nodes.desc: Performs async HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 requests used by HTTP-family outputs and exporters.

nodes.label: flb_me_create()
nodes.desc: Runs the embedded HTTP metrics endpoint aggregating engine health counters.
